reviews.title: They want even more money!
reviews.text:
=====
Update: They found a way to make you pay even more! They now allow ADSB look up (they call it Flight Lookup), BUT, only if you pay even more money. Paying £80 per year for the iPhone+iPad logbook isn’t enough, you now have to pay £129 per year for the “Pro” version, just to get the flight look up, even if you dont have or want a Mac. Seriously, take it from a professional pilot. I have over 15,000 hrs flying airliners so I have a pretty good idea what makes a good logbook. Just go and buy LOGGER. It has EVERYTHING you need, with a better interface, and yet they manage to do it for only £29 per year. 
=====
I’ve been with LTP since 2006. Twenty years. And now I’ve left.

That, in itself, probably says more than anything else I could write.

Before subscription pricing was introduced, there was a major update every couple of years. There had to be. The only way to generate new revenue was to build the next big improvement and give existing users a reason to upgrade.

Now, with a very expensive subscription model generating recurring revenue regardless, the pace of innovation appears to have slowed to a crawl. There have been very few genuinely significant additions or improvements since subscriptions were introduced. Why push for the “next big thing” when the money is already coming in?

After 20 years, some of the omissions are frankly difficult to understand.

reviews.title: Missing flights
reviews.text: I’ve used Logten for the past 3 years and have 1300 hours logged into it. I just barely spent over $100 to subscribe for the year and now I have flights missing across my devices. My Mac, iPad and iPhone all show different times. I tried asking for help from support, but I have to go through their AI chatbot first. I can’t get a response froma team member even though it says I should get a response in 3 hours. It’s been 3 days. Not worth $100 dollars a year for no support and a logbook I can’t trust.

reviews.title: Constant Syncing issue
reviews.text: It’s frustrating that syncing is a constant issue that never fixes. Syncing was working fine! And they have to make an “update” to ruin it. Version 2026.2.2. “Enhanced sync and backup”, “Stability and performance updates” absolutely BS, made  it worse & unusable.

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: Expensive subscription for an app that is essentially not functional for any of the advanced features that I was hopeful to utilize. Works great for doing any of the functions that are cheaper or free on many other platforms.

reviews.title: Lost all data
reviews.text: Upgraded to the new version, my logbook was on the device and it deleted everything. Now support won’t even contact me 48hours after raising a ticket. Awful

reviews.title: No control over my logbook
reviews.text: There is no web interface, so you don’t have control to go online and make changes to your logbook, look at the big picture, or make simple edits to your logbook. The only way to do it is through customer service, and they are just horrible. Seriously, google their reputation. They take weeks to get back to you, and they don’t provide any helpful actions.

reviews.title: Random discrepancies between devices
reviews.text: Same issues years later. When saving a backup it records the correct number of flights with the incorrect number of hours. When combing through 1500 entries it turns out it arbitrarily drops a leg (easy to spot) or changes a leg time (eg. 7.3-4.3, not easy to spot and requires a second logbook to reconcile). In other words, don’t get rid of that paper logbook folks.

reviews.title: I would not recommend anyone to buy this - personal opinion
reviews.text: All of a sudden the app stopped working says loading… syncing logbook from cloud. It happened on all devices that has access to my logbook (phone and iPad). Tried every troubleshooting step, didn’t work and tried contacting support no response from them for 5 hours now and no phone number to call. Very unresponsive even with the urgency mentioned in the email. Some reviews said people logbooks were reset. I cannot confirm that as I cannot login and a subscriber.

reviews.title: Way buggy and it always freezes in sync
reviews.text: The sync function never works and it doesn’t add up your hours correctly. About once a month it gets stuck on the losing page when you first open the app and won’t get past it. It takes a few weeks of losing for the app to start working again.

reviews.title: Import service doesn’t work as advertised
reviews.text:
One of the main reasons I upgraded was the promise that LogTen would import my airline schedule and flight data. Unfortunately, the import process has been unreliable, inconsistent, and in my case, simply not performed. The website and support documentation describe an import service that doesn’t match the reality of what users receive.

Support initially told me imports would be handled monthly, then quarterly, and eventually said they could not import my file at all—despite it being the same format they previously accepted. Each response contradicted the last, and no clear explanation or solution was provided.

For an app at this price point, the import feature should work as advertised or at least be supported consistently. Instead, I’ve spent more time trying to get basic functionality than actually logging flights. If you’re subscribing specifically for the import service, be aware that it may not be delivered.

reviews.title: Misleading features, broken imports, and no meaningful support
reviews.text:
I purchased LogTen based on the advertised features and airline integrations, but the actual product doesn’t match what’s promoted. The import/export system is unreliable, inconsistent, and fails on basic data validation. Even simple roster imports require constant manual correction, and the app behaves unpredictably with larger datasets. Several features listed on their website either don’t work as described or are missing entirely.

Support responses are slow and often contradict their own documentation. When issues are escalated, the answers shift depending on who replies, and there’s no clear resolution path. After discovering these problems, I attempted to request a refund through Apple, but LogTen’s support insisted everything was working “as intended” despite clear evidence to the contrary.

If you’re expecting a stable, professional-grade logbook with reliable airline integrations, be cautious. The marketing doesn’t reflect the actual product experience, and once you subscribe, there’s no practical recourse when the app fails to deliver.

reviews.title: Repeat crashes and hours of waiting for help
reviews.text: App was working fine until I tried to edit entries today and then proceeded to crash repeatedly with no way to log in. Basically useless now and may force me to cancel my subscription if this isn’t resolved ASAP.

reviews.title: Will not count flight hours
reviews.text: The app will import flights from fcview, that’s great. But it is not increasing my total time. I’m going to have to go back in and count up my flights to update logs which was the the whole point of a digital logbook. The only reason is not one star is because of it linking to fcview

reviews.title: Latest update breaks the app.
reviews.text: After years as a satisfied paying customer, including as an original beta tester, I am sad to say that the LogTen Pro is unusable for me after its last update. Upon launch, the app hangs on the splash screen, reading, “Loading… Authenticating… “ for up to two minutes or more, sometimes requiring a swipe to close and relaunch. It seems the app attempts to connect to the Internet before allowing a flight to be logged. If this is the case, the app is now useless. As an Alaskan bush pilot, I am almost never connected when I log flights.

reviews.title: Latests update flaw.
reviews.text: App will not open up when in Airplane mode!

reviews.title: Use at Your Own Risk!
reviews.text: I used this app for a couple years and logged many flights.  Then one day, I discovered they updated the software and my database would no longer load.  I sent two requests to update my database to their new and “improved(???)” software, but no reply.  I lost years of logbook data due to this app!!

reviews.title: Great, but can be confusing
reviews.text: I really like most of the features of this logbook,  getting it setup just right is a pain. The information about how to set things up is lacking or is confusing. It would be nice if they added a feature within the app or with each selection that had a way to describe what each selection does. Provide examples of how to set some parameters up. This app can be very powerful, if you know how to use it.
